verdict.rationale: The axis applies, since a sales-tax compliance product could ship its own AI assistant. Nothing in the evidence pack shows TaxJar offering an AI that answers taxability or invoice-explanation questions from its rule base with citations. The documented features are a tax calculation API, product tax codes, nexus tracking and AutoFile, none of which is a conversational, cited explanation tool.

support.subject: As a founder, the product ships its own AI for tax questions — is this product taxable in this state, why did this invoice tax this way — answering from its rule base with citations, not a generic chatbot
